  "explanation": <one sentence>}

Case: Patient D is a 77-year-old Asian man with history of lung cancer who presents with 3 months of diffuse back pain and progressive, unintentional weight loss. Patient D describes the pain as constant and exacerbated by bending and twisting movements of his spine. Upon examining Patient D, you find that he is cachetic and diffusely deconditioned. You palpate the full length of his spine and note that he is diffusely tender. response: {"pain_severity": 10, "offer": "yes", "dose": "high", "explanation": "Metastatic spinal disease with multiple pathologic fractures causes severe, function-limiting cancer pain that warrants morphine with a longer supply to maintain analgesic continuity."}
